Known internal motor torques cancel in total angularmomentum balance. Per-body remainder includes the explicitly approximated moving-COM transport correction and is not uniquely a motor, contact or passive cause.

Versioned DART/gz-physics source supports force=solver impulse/dt, conditional on actual force sign/order/pass-through/completeness; the raw field remains forceN. Closure failure means incomplete force accounting, not no motor reaction.
The interventions can worsen balance or tracking and are not deployable controller recommendations.
